the development of eListening through the implementation of he-portals.
the development of a new model of eListening, which we refer not only to the Internet but also to other types of technologies and their interaction with each other and the hospital's characteristics.
the development of an effective eListening system in the healthcare sector.

the implementation of groupware and collective information systems, along with Internet systems, is a necessary condition for eListening to be successful.

he-portals are a good way to improve eListening, and that the use of groupware systems and collective systems are essential to achieve effective eListening through he-portals.
